A **dermastamp** (or derma stamp) is `a handheld microneedling tool with a cluster of fine, vertical needles that create tiny, controlled punctures in the skin or scalp`.[[1]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)[[2]](https://www.walmart.com/c/kp/dermastamp)

### How It Works & Benefits

- **Vertical Motion:** Unlike traditional derma rollers—which roll across the skin at an angle and can catch or tear hair and tissue—a dermastamp moves straight up and down at a 90-degree angle.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)[[2]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)
- **Collagen & Elastin Stimulation:** The micro-channels trigger the body's natural healing response, encouraging new collagen and elastin production to smooth texture and reduce the look of fine lines or scars.[[1]](https://stanartis.com/en/blogs/beauty-tips/dermastamp-cos-e-e-come-si-utilizza)[[2]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)
- **Enhanced Absorption:** Creating micro-channels helps topical products—such as hair-growth serums or minoxidil—penetrate the skin and scalp much more effectively.[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/products/rhute-dermastamp)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JttiJrbcepM)

### General Usage & Guidelines

- **Needle Lengths:** Adjustable dials typically range from **0.5 mm** (for superficial absorption and light scalp/face care) up to **1.5 mm – 3.0 mm** (for deeper scars or body use, though longer needles carry higher risks).[[1]](https://us.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/0J_GJ_eRnFc)
- **Sterilization:** The stamp head must be sanitized in **70% to 100% isopropyl alcohol** before and after every use.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BBgZq7KYOw0)[[2]](https://us.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/0J_GJ_eRnFc)
- **Frequency:** Most at-home routines recommend using the device **once or twice a week** , pressing gently without dragging, and avoiding broken skin, active acne, or inflamed scalp conditions.[[1]](https://www.themainsolution.store/products/derma-stamp)[[2]](https://rhutehair.com/products/rhute-dermastamp)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BBgZq7KYOw0)
- **Popular Options:** Devices like the [DRS by Dr. Pen Derma Stamp](https://drpen.net/products/dr-pen-derma-stamp-140-pins-derma-pen-for-face-body-hair-beard-growth?variant=41489332142168&country=US&currency=USD&utm_medium=product_sync&utm_source=google&utm_content=sag_organic&utm_campaign=sag_organic) or options available via [Amazon Derma Stamp Listings](https://www.amazon.com/derma-stamp/s?k=derma+stamp) and [Target Skincare Tools](https://www.target.com/s/derma+stamp) typically feature 140 adjustable pins and cost around $15 to $30.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/derma-stamp/s?k=derma+stamp)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12364467628364247079,catalogid:14679707962730419830,gpcid:11857634587116834912,mid:576462502624445181&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.target.com/s/derma+stamp)[[4]](https://us.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp)
